The best thing about it for me is it allows me to actually wear more items out of my closet by logging my outfits in the calendar. So I can scroll and see okay I wore this then. As well as it being able to suggest an item or whole outfit I haven’t worn. 

The team is helpful as well I reached out because I had questions about some of the features and the responded next day. 

For me choosing my outfit in the morning took so much time, being indecisive and wanting to look “stylish”. This app has given me back that time. To see an outfit it put together, be easily able to change an item if want, and see an avatar of myself wearing it; it truly is a game changer in my planning and productivity. apple.release_notes:
Meet the new Essembl!

A brand-new design, built around four tabs:

• Today: daily outfits for the weather and your plans, at the time you choose
• Studio: build outfits on a canvas, get ideas and a Rate me score
• Rate my look: snap a selfie, get tips, add what you're wearing to your wardrobe
• Shop: find what your wardrobe is missing, and style it with your own clothes

Plus outfit folders, a new widget, sharing to WhatsApp, and lots of fixes.

reviews.title: Willing to adjust this later
reviews.body:
I just downloaded the app, so I’m willing to give it some time as I explore its features. However, my initial experience has been disappointing, particularly with the accuracy of item recognition and the quality of the styling recommendations.

Nearly every shoe and clothing item I’ve uploaded has been identified incorrectly, often returning results that look nothing like the original. This is a significant issue for an app designed to help organize and style a wardrobe. I shouldn’t have to rely on a separate image search feature to compensate for consistently inaccurate results.

The outfit recommendations also need substantial improvement. So far, the suggested combinations have been outdated, tacky, poorly coordinated, and lacking any real sense of style. Rather than offering fresh, fashionable, and cohesive looks, the recommendations feel random and disconnected from what someone would realistically want to wear.

I understand that no app is perfect, especially when first learning

reviews.title: Does not consider time
reviews.body:
The app doesn’t allow you to input how much time you’ve owned a piece, so ratings about your wardrobe’s sustainability are mostly superficial and related to brand, not whether or not you’ve kept your clothes from going in the dumpster. Many sustainability problems have to do with waste. 

A Reformation dress that you wear once and throw away is not necessarily sustainable, even though the brand rates very highly on this app. 

It’s a well designed enough app, with some cool features, but for anyone whose been into sustainability for a while, it lacks nuance. The app seems mostly like a way to encourage shoppers to buy expensive brands, which not all of us can afford. 

An H&M shirt that you’ve had for five years is still sustainable - in its own way. The most important part is keeping your clothes and caring for them in whatever way you can to avoid creating waste. 

If you’re new to these concepts the app might be fun, if not, I wouldn’t recommend it for the purposes of sustainability

reviews.title: 使用体验很棒
reviews.body:
Ai功能很优秀，
但是还有希望改进的地方：
1淘宝导入有许多订单识别不到，依然需要手填
2因可以淘宝账号导入，因此淘宝内购买的商品可以点击链接看详情，就可以看见很多详细信息。但淘宝外购买的，就很难分辨物品。
以鞋为例，有些鞋设计的极其相似，只有一个面稍有不同，如果一个物品可以不只含有主视图（Ai搭配可以依然基于主产品图搭配），同时，能添加两到三个图辅助判断（比如主视图+左/右侧面图+俯视图，甚至可以补拍一个鞋盒样式便于平常查找，不至于挨个翻鞋盒子，那将在搭配的同时，实现收纳功能，使用场景更加广泛，用户更加便利）
（十分期盼添加多张照片功能上线，毕竟很多东西不是备注文字就能描述清楚的，辛苦考虑一下我的建议🫰🏻）

reviews.title: 希望增加灵感看板功能
reviews.body:
终于找到想要的 APP 了，但还是有一些没有达到预期，提一些我的小小建议，希望可以采纳
1.希望真正是一个好的工具，而不是一个为淘宝导流的 APP。毕竟大家的衣服并不都是来自淘宝。
更开发者可以强调它的工具属性，把社区和购买的建议放在后面。不然会像蘑菇街一样黄掉。
2.希望可以方便的在图片上增加描述文字，做出来的效果类似于日本杂志那样。现在的备注在最下方，有点不起眼了。
3.因为衣帽间都有不同的衣柜。
希望给不同类型的衣服进行分区，比如说运动的、职场的、周末的。这样不会所有的衣服堆在同一个衣柜里，会比较混乱。

v1.2 - 你的 AI 造型师更聪明了

7天天气智能穿搭规划
打开「穿搭规划」标签，蜜根据你所在地区未来 7 天的天气，包括温度、湿度、降雨，智能推荐每天的穿搭。雨天提前备好风衣，降温前换上毛衣。

AI 透明度全面升级
首次使用 AI 功能时，全新的同意页面清楚列出每个第三方 AI 服务的名称、用途、数据流向。Google Gemini 用于图像分析，OpenRouter 与 DeepSeek 用于文字生成，fal.ai 用于图像生成，Open-Meteo 用于天气数据。你可以选择不使用 AI，把蜜穿搭当成手动搭配参考。

脸型分析提速 60%
脸型与身材分析现在 10 秒出结果，之前需要 25 秒。换搭配再也不用等。

衣橱图库
离线收藏最多 100 套穿搭，飞机上、地铁里、信号差也能翻看心头好。

原生 iOS 分享
一键分享穿搭卡片到微信、小红书、Instagram 等任何应用。

键盘体验优化
聊天框不再被键盘遮挡，输入流畅。

性能优化
慢网络下图片上传速度提升 40%，海外旅游也不卡。

修复内容
- 时区显示错误
- 离线模式偶发崩溃
- 部分机型脸型扫描卡顿

谢谢你使用蜜穿搭。问题反馈：support@silkvo.com
